bullet:
* `Becoming.Sensitivity` (L4): the least registration with any number of conditions, with no
  premise beyond what each law names. A law reading finitely many conditions under each history,
  the list possibly depending on the history, reads through what it is sensitive to: sensitivity
  is the least registration it reads through, and the comparison as the dynamics give holds with
  any number of conditions; such a law sensitive to no condition gives alike under every two
  histories. With infinitely many conditions this cannot be dropped: given a decision of whether
  levels vanish from some condition on, which gives the limited principle of omniscience, a law
  of the tail is sensitive to no condition and still differs, and the registrations it reads
  through have no least one; with the conditions numbered, every counterexample to the least
  registration gives the weak limited principle of omniscience.
readme_row: | L4 | [`Becoming.Sensitivity`](Becoming/Sensitivity.lean) | 任意多条件下最小的识（除了各律所写者不加前提）：律在每一步、对每个形成、在每个历史下读某个有限的条件列表之内（`ExchangeLaw.ReadsWithin`、`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely`，列表可随历史而变）时，读已立者（`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.nonanticipating`），经其敏感而读（`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.through_sensitive`），敏感是它所经的最小的识（`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.least_registration`），由动力学给出的比较对任意多的条件成立（`comparison_through_sensitivity_of_readsFinitely`），条件有限的情形是一个实例（`ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive_of_every`）；这样的律不敏感于任何条件时，在每两个历史下给出相同（`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.alike_of_insensitive`）；律可以在每个历史下读有限多个条件，却不在任一列表之内读所有历史（`Pointer.readsFinitely`、`Pointer.no_list`）；条件无穷多时这一条件不能去掉：给定水平是否从某个条件起消失的判定（它给出有限全知原则，`lpo_of_vanish_decided`），尾之律不敏感于任何条件而仍有差别（`tailLaw_not_sensitive`、`tailLaw_differs`），它所经的识没有最小的（`tailLaw_no_least_registration`）；条件以自然数编号时，最小的识的每个反例都给出弱有限全知原则（`wlpo_of_not_through_sensitive`、`WLPO`），不敏感于任何条件而仍有差别的律亦然（`wlpo_of_insensitive_differs`）；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren / the least registration with any number of conditions (no premise beyond what each law names): a law that at every step, for every formation and under every history reads within some finite list of conditions (`ExchangeLaw.ReadsWithin`, `ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely`, the list possibly depending on the history) reads what has stood (`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.nonanticipating`) and reads through what it is sensitive to (`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.through_sensitive`), sensitivity being the least registration it reads through (`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.least_registration`); the comparison as the dynamics give holds with any number of conditions (`comparison_through_sensitivity_of_readsFinitely`), the case of finitely many being an instance (`ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive_of_every`); such a law sensitive to no condition gives alike under every two histories (`ExchangeLaw.ReadsFinitely.alike_of_insensitive`); a law can read finitely many conditions under each history and within no one list under all (`Pointer.readsFinitely`, `Pointer.no_list`); with infinitely many conditions this cannot be dropped: given a decision of whether levels vanish from some condition on (which gives the limited principle of omniscience, `lpo_of_vanish_decided`), the tail law is sensitive to no condition and still differs (`tailLaw_not_sensitive`, `tailLaw_differs`), and the registrations it reads through have no least one (`tailLaw_no_least_registration`); with the conditions numbered by the natural numbers, every counterexample to the least registration gives the weak limited principle of omniscience (`wlpo_of_not_through_sensitive`, `WLPO`), as does every law insensitive to every condition that still differs (`wlpo_of_insensitive_differs`); the readings are the AI's, pending Ren |
chapter_row: | L4 | [Becoming.Sensitivity](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Sensitivity.lean) | 任意多条件下最小的识（除了各律所写者不加前提）：律在每个历史下读有限多个条件（列表可随历史而变）时，读已立者并经其敏感而读，敏感是它所经的最小的识，由动力学给出的比较对任意多的条件成立，条件有限的情形是一个实例；这样的律不敏感于任何条件时处处给出相同；条件无穷多时这一条件不能去掉：给定水平是否终将消失的判定（它给出有限全知原则），尾之律不敏感于任何条件而仍有差别，它所经的识没有最小的；条件以自然数编号时，每个反例都给出弱有限全知原则。/ The least registration with any number of conditions, with no premise beyond what each law names: a law reading finitely many conditions under each history, the list possibly depending on the history, reads what has stood and reads through what it is sensitive to, sensitivity being the least registration it reads through, and the comparison as the dynamics give holds with any number of conditions, the finite case being an instance; such a law sensitive to no condition gives alike everywhere; with infinitely many conditions this cannot be dropped: given a decision of whether levels vanish eventually, which gives the limited principle of omniscience, the tail law is sensitive to no condition and still differs, and the registrations it reads through have no least one; with the conditions numbered, every counterexample gives the weak limited principle of omniscience. | 47 |
